title: The third tribulation; Lu Xueqi sets out (Season 3 finale)
summary: The third strike of the heavenly tribulation falls. Pu Hong tries to take it on himself, and Fa Xiang rushes to save his master. Stripped of his power, Gui Li sinks towards death, and loving voices call him home, asking whether he has suffered enough. He almost goes, then refuses: he owes too much to the world to give it up, and even if heaven destroys his cultivation and his body, the people in his heart stay. Saying that between heaven and earth he is simply Zhang Xiaofan, he survives with help from a presence he recognises. At Qingyun, Lu Xueqi is charged with letting a demon go for personal feelings and causing the Zhu Xian Sword to break. Her master tells her the story of Tianya, forged 800 years ago from Nine Heavens Mysterious Iron, and says the sword was waiting for her. With the Beast Deity fled badly wounded and Qingyun stretched thin, the leaders agree to send elite disciples to track it, and Lu Xueqi volunteers to make up for her fault; Shui Yue lets her go, telling her to live up to the people and to her sword. At Tian Yin Temple the Wordless Jade Wall is damaged, but Pu Hong says he has no regrets. Gui Li takes his leave, saying he has seen through the world and is still himself, unwilling to let go of the people he cares for.
